label: pin-count
command: uses=$(grep -hE "^\s*-?\s*uses: " .github/workflows/*.yml) || exit 1; bad=$(printf "%s\n" "$uses" | grep -vcE "@[0-9a-f]{40} # v?[0-9]"); rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$bad"; test "$rc" -le 1 && test "$bad" -eq 0

label: matrix
command: if grep -nE "[[:punct:]]8\.3[[:punct:]]|Boxed profile" .github/workflows/*.yml; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 1 || exit; fi; grep -n "matrix.postgres" .github/workflows/ci.yml
stdout:
93:    name: PG lane (postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}) · Laravel ${{ matrix.laravel }}
96:        image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}
